entries.title: Proverbs 18:1
segments: ¶He who keeps himself separate for his private purpose goes against all good sense.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:2
segments: ¶A foolish man has no pleasure in good sense, but only to let what is in his heart come to light.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:3
segments: ¶When the evil-doer comes, a low opinion comes with him, and with the loss of honour comes shame.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:4
segments: ¶The words of a man's mouth are like deep waters: the fountain of wisdom is like a flowing stream.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:5
segments: ¶To have respect for the person of the evil-doer is not good, or to give a wrong decision against the upright.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:6
segments: ¶A foolish man's lips are a cause of fighting, and his mouth makes him open to blows.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:7
segments: The mouth of a foolish man is his destruction, and his lips are a net for his soul.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:8
segments: ¶The words of one who says evil of his neighbour secretly are like sweet food, and go down into the inner parts of the stomach.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:9
segments: ¶He who does not give his mind to his work is brother to him who makes destruction.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:10
segments: ¶The name of the Lord is a strong tower: the upright man running into it is safe.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:11
segments: ¶The property of a man of wealth is his strong town, and it is as a high wall in the thoughts of his heart.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:12
segments: ¶Before destruction the heart of man is full of pride, and before honour goes a gentle spirit.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:13
segments: ¶To give an answer before hearing is a foolish thing and a cause of shame.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:14
segments: ¶The spirit of a man will be his support when he is ill; but how may a broken spirit be lifted up?

entries.title: Proverbs 18:15
segments: ¶The heart of the man of good sense gets knowledge; the ear of the wise is searching for knowledge.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:16
segments: ¶A man's offering makes room for him, letting him come before great men.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:17
segments: ¶The man who first puts his cause before the judge seems to be in the right; but then his neighbour comes and puts his cause in its true light.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:18
segments: ¶The decision of chance puts an end to argument, parting the strong.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:19
segments: ¶A brother wounded is like a strong town, and violent acts are like a locked tower.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:20
segments: ¶With the fruit of a man's mouth his stomach will be full; the produce of his lips will be his in full measure.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:21
segments: ¶Death and life are in the power of the tongue; and those to whom it is dear will have its fruit for their food.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:22
segments: ¶Whoever gets a wife gets a good thing, and has the approval of the Lord.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:23
segments: ¶The poor man makes requests for grace, but the man of wealth gives a rough answer.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:24
segments: ¶There are friends who may be a man's destruction, but there is a lover who keeps nearer than a brother.
